subject: ancient-history
topicName: Pericles & the Golden Age of Athens

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Pericles dominated Athenian politics for over 30 years (c. 461-429 BC), elected strategos repeatedly

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Athenian building programme: Parthenon, Propylaea, Erechtheion on the Acropolis, funded by Delian League tribute

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Pericles' Funeral Oration (431 BC, recorded by Thucydides) celebrated Athenian democracy, freedom and cultural superiority

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Peloponnesian War (431-404 BC) between Athens and Sparta devastated Greece and ended the Athenian Golden Age

steps.title: Try it yourself

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Pericles = strategos repeatedly elected, not a tyrant or king Building programme = funded by tribute, controversial with allies Funeral Oration = Thucydides' version, idealised, not a verbatim transcript Peloponnesian War: Spartan fear of Athens + Athenian imperialism
